displayName: GCP runaway egress - ua-worker storage (would have caught the Sep 2026 litestream bleed)

conditions.displayName: Any bucket in the project egress over 10 GiB/hour

documentation.content:
Runaway Cloud Storage egress detected in project ua-worker.

Baseline is 0 GiB/hour for these buckets. This alert fires when a bucket sends more than 5 GiB/hour (backups bucket) or 10 GiB/hour (any bucket).

Known cause to check first: an un-pruned litestream replica. The L0 retention loop paginates the whole object prefix and the listing RESPONSE PAYLOAD is billed internet egress. In Sep 2026 this produced ~600 GiB/day (~$65/day) for six days.

First checks:
  gcloud storage ls gs://ua-worker-backups-000000000000/litestream/
  pgrep -fl 'litestream replicate'   (on the Mac hub)

Response: stop the listing process first (any credential restored will re-arm the loop), then investigate.
